{{Infobox Slayer |name = Zombies |skillreq = None |combatreq = {{SCP|Combat|10}} |otherreq = None |turael = 15-30 |spria = 15-30 |krystilia = 75-125 |mazchna = 30-50 |id = No }} [[Zombie|Zombies]] can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] at level 10 [[combat]] by various [[Slayer master|Slayer masters]]. Zombies are most often found in places that depict death, such as graveyards. [[Monkey Zombie|Monkey Zombies]], [[Undead chicken|Undead chickens]], [[Undead cow|Undead cows]], [[Undead Druid|Undead Druids]], [[Undead one|Undead ones]], [[Vorkath]], [[Zogre|Zogres]], and [[Zombie rat|Zombie rats]] can all be killed to satisfy the task. The [[Zombies Champion]] does '''not''' count towards the task. Zombies are primarily ignored as they have a very poor drop table, though players who are assigned them have the option of killing [[Undead Druid]]s or [[Vorkath]], provided they have the requirements to do so. When assigned by [[Krystilia]] as part of a Wilderness task, zombies are more lucrative, with players having the option of killing [[zombie pirate]]s, who have a generous drop table provided that the player has completed the Medium [[Wilderness Diary]]. If not killing the pirates, the only options are the [[Graveyard of Shadows]] and the [[Ruins (east)|eastern ruins]], both of which are popular player killing hotspots due to being next to the lairs of [[Calvar'ion]] and [[Spindel]] respectively. The Graveyard of Shadows is more open and thus a cannon is more effective there. Undead cows and chickens are good for players who wish to quickly complete the task. It is not recommended to kill Monkey Zombies, as they have no tradeable or useful non-[[Quests|quest]] drops.
